outcome_class_rules.existing_target_link: Compensate or repair migration metadata only; never mutate, delete, restore, redirect or enrich the existing target or its children, and prove target mutation is zero.
outcome_class_rules.allocated_number: Reuse the exact durable allocation for the patient-core idempotency key; never allocate a replacement, decrement or recycle a committed number, and classify all consumption as committed, transactionally released or explained.
outcome_class_rules.committed_atomic_unit: Resolve the exact compatible unit by protected lineage and repair only missing reconciliation or checkpoint facts; never repeat its target writes or delete/recreate it merely to recover metadata.
outcome_class_rules.incomplete_atomic_unit: Prefer transaction rollback before commit; if partial facts escaped the atomic boundary, enter an explicit compensation state and isolate them pending reviewed recovery.
outcome_class_rules.hard_delete: Hard deletion is never a universal rollback and is not authorized by this specification.

records.durable_facts: Classification, selected branch, patient-core idempotency inputs, pinned source/target/configuration coordinates and measured zero target delta.
records.safe_retry: Restart preflight and classification against the same pinned coordinates; if any coordinate changed, stop and reclassify before allocation.
records.duplicate_prevention: Resolve any compatible patient mapping and number-allocation lineage before allocator entry; prove that no Unit A intent, patient write or allocation already exists.
records.rollback_feasibility: Nothing has been allocated or written, so no target rollback is feasible or required.
records.compensation_requirement: None when zero delta is proven; any unexplained durable target or allocator fact fails closed to COMPENSATION_REQUIRED.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Keep the last verified checkpoint at CLASSIFIED and do not create a Unit A success checkpoint.
records.reconciliation_proof: Zero patient, mapping, allocation and prohibited-side-effect deltas at the pinned coordinate.
records.operator_action: Refresh preflight and classification when a coordinate changed; otherwise no intervention is required.

records.boundary: After number allocation, before patient commit
records.durable_facts: The exact allocator outcome, patient-core idempotency key, numbering-configuration fingerprint, pinned period, transaction identity and allocation status.
records.safe_retry: Reuse the exact durable allocation only after its lineage and collision coordinate agree; never allocate a replacement number.
records.duplicate_prevention: Enforce one compatible allocation per patient-core key and recheck patient, archive and alias namespaces before any patient retry; a unique-key collision alone is not success.
records.rollback_feasibility: Release only when the reviewed allocator proves transactional rollback/release; never manually decrement or recycle a committed allocation.
records.compensation_requirement: Preserve explained consumption when safe release cannot be proven; unexplained consumption enters COMPENSATION_REQUIRED for allocator review.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain CORE_COMMITTING; record the allocation fact but do not advance a patient-core success checkpoint.
records.reconciliation_proof: The sequence equation classifies the allocation exactly as committed, transactionally released or explained, with zero unexplained difference.
records.operator_action: Investigate every unexplained allocation or sequence difference before retry.

records.boundary: After patient commit, before crosswalk commit
records.durable_facts: Patient write-set evidence, exact allocated number, Unit A transaction/intent identity, patient-core idempotency key and operational-isolation evidence.
records.safe_retry: Stop normal retry; never infer ownership from patient likeness, create a second patient or allocate a replacement number. Resume only from exact durable intent and target proof.
records.duplicate_prevention: Require exact protected lineage between intent, allocation and target row; neither row equality nor a target unique key proves prior migration ownership.
records.rollback_feasibility: Roll back all of Unit A only if the transaction is still uncommitted and atomic rollback is proven; a separately committed patient row is not a committed Unit A and must not be hard-deleted as a universal rollback.
records.compensation_requirement: A durable patient without the crosswalk/provenance/core-reconciliation bundle is an atomicity breach: isolate operational use, create a protected orphan-migration outcome and require owner-controlled recovery or compensation.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Do not write CORE_COMMITTED; record COMPENSATION_REQUIRED against the prior CORE_COMMITTING checkpoint.
records.reconciliation_proof: Patient, allocation, mapping, provenance and core-reconciliation facts must either all agree as one Unit A or be recorded as an explicit inconsistency; no partial state passes.
records.operator_action: Migration operator and migration architect jointly review recovery or compensation before any retry.

records.durable_facts: The exact committed Unit A bundle: patient, allocated number, protected crosswalk, provenance, core-reconciliation result, transaction identity and write-set checksum.
records.safe_retry: Resolve the same committed Unit A by its protected idempotency lineage and repair only the missing checkpoint; do not repeat target writes or allocate another number.
records.duplicate_prevention: The crosswalk and patient-core key must resolve to one exact target and one exact number; any conflict or missing bundle fact fails closed.
records.rollback_feasibility: No rollback is required or authorized merely because the checkpoint is missing; do not delete and recreate a committed atomic unit.
records.compensation_requirement: None when the complete Unit A bundle still agrees; drift or bundle inconsistency enters COMPENSATION_REQUIRED rather than checkpoint repair.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Create the missing CORE_COMMITTED checkpoint only after compare-and-verify of all durable Unit A facts.
records.reconciliation_proof: The target/mapping checksum, allocation equation and core equation reproduce the stored passing result with zero difference at the same coordinate.
records.operator_action: Perform controlled checkpoint recovery; escalate any drift or lineage conflict.

records.durable_facts: Committed core mapping, alias idempotency key, source duplicate class, target collision coordinate, Unit B intent and alias pre-state fingerprint.
records.safe_retry: Recheck parent, source class and all alias/number namespaces; return only an exact compatible prior migration alias, otherwise create once or withhold under the current classification.
records.duplicate_prevention: Use the protected alias lineage and enforced normalized typed-alias uniqueness; target row equality or a duplicate database key alone is not success.
records.rollback_feasibility: Roll back an uncommitted Unit B independently; the committed patient core and allocated number remain unchanged.
records.compensation_requirement: If partial Unit B facts escaped the atomic boundary, compensate Unit B metadata/row by a reviewed alias-specific action; never compensate by deleting the core. Collision or changed evidence produces a durable withheld outcome.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain ALIAS_PENDING until alias-or-withheld outcome, provenance and reconciliation agree; then advance exactly once to ALIAS_COMMITTED or ALIAS_WITHHELD.
records.reconciliation_proof: Alias mapping, provenance, duplicate/collision classification and PATIENT-REC-ALIAS-002 equation agree with zero difference.
records.operator_action: Withhold and review when collision state or lineage changed; otherwise resume Unit B by exact key.

records.durable_facts: Committed core mapping, contact idempotency key, tuple classification, Unit C intent, parent fingerprint and complete pre-contact-set/primary-count fingerprint.
records.safe_retry: Recheck the parent and one-primary invariant; return only an exact compatible prior migration contact, otherwise create once or withhold the optional child.
records.duplicate_prevention: Require protected contact lineage and tuple key; row equality is insufficient, and existing-target contacts are immutable and never reused by similarity.
records.rollback_feasibility: Roll back an uncommitted Unit C independently; the patient core remains and no existing-target contact may be edited or deleted.
records.compensation_requirement: If partial Unit C facts escaped the atomic boundary, use reviewed contact-specific compensation or withhold the child; never delete the patient core or alter existing-target children.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain CONTACT_PENDING until contact-or-withheld outcome, provenance, one-primary proof and reconciliation agree; then advance once to CONTACT_COMMITTED or CONTACT_WITHHELD.
records.reconciliation_proof: Contact mapping/provenance equations and the target one-primary count pass with zero difference and zero existing-target mutation.
records.operator_action: Withhold the optional child when safe completion cannot be proven; review any primary-count or existing-target difference.

records.durable_facts: Complete protected group manifest, one history intent and idempotency key per source insurance row, source-row provenance and each row's transaction outcome.
records.safe_retry: Resume only missing source-row history outcomes by exact keys; return compatible completed rows unchanged and stop on conflicting or unexplained lineage.
records.duplicate_prevention: Enforce one compatible history outcome per protected source-row token and retain separate lineage for exact duplicate source rows; no source row may collapse or disappear.
records.rollback_feasibility: Roll back an incomplete row transaction or complete its protected metadata under the reviewed cross-resource protocol; already committed compatible row outcomes remain unchanged.
records.compensation_requirement: Partial cross-resource facts require row-specific compensation/recovery and an explicit pending outcome; compensation must not discard a source row or undo patient core.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain INSURANCE_HISTORY_PENDING until every group source row has one durable terminal history outcome; advance once to INSURANCE_HISTORY_COMMITTED only for the complete group.
records.reconciliation_proof: INS-REC-014 and the group source-count/history-outcome equation pass exactly; every source row has provenance and zero unexplained difference.
records.operator_action: Reprocess the affected protected row set and hold the group while any row is missing, failed or conflicting.

records.durable_facts: Complete committed history, patient/provider group key, exact patient and provider mappings, Unit D-current intent, initialization decision and target membership collision coordinate/pre-set.
records.safe_retry: Recheck complete history, mappings, initialization and unique group state; return only an exact compatible prior migration membership, otherwise create once or withhold current representation.
records.duplicate_prevention: Enforce one compatible current outcome per patient/provider group and at most one current target representation; a duplicate database key or similar existing membership is not migration success.
records.rollback_feasibility: Roll back the uncommitted Unit D-current group independently; committed history remains and unrelated or existing-target memberships are never updated or deleted.
records.compensation_requirement: Partial Unit D-current facts require group-specific reviewed compensation/recovery; collision, unresolved initialization or changed state produces INSURANCE_CURRENT_WITHHELD without mutating existing memberships.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain INSURANCE_CURRENT_PENDING until current-or-withheld outcome and reconciliation agree; then advance once to INSURANCE_CURRENT_COMMITTED or INSURANCE_CURRENT_WITHHELD.
records.reconciliation_proof: All group source rows remain accounted, history is complete, at most one current representation exists and existing-target membership mutation is zero.
records.operator_action: Hold the group and refresh collision/initialization evidence when exact compatible completion cannot be proven.

records.durable_facts: Exact committed atomic-unit identity, target write set, transaction outcome, protected mappings/provenance, idempotency lineage and measured post-state.
records.safe_retry: Stop later stages and reconstruct reconciliation from durable facts without repeating any target write; resolve each committed unit by exact protected lineage.
records.duplicate_prevention: Treat exact compatible committed units as already written; never recreate them to obtain missing reconciliation, and fail closed on an unexplained target row or conflicting lineage.
records.rollback_feasibility: Do not roll back or hard-delete a valid committed atomic unit merely because reconciliation is delayed; if reconciliation fails, only a reviewed unit-specific rollback or compensation may be considered.
records.compensation_requirement: None while reconciliation is pending and facts agree; a failed equation or partial atomic unit enters RECONCILIATION_FAILED or COMPENSATION_REQUIRED and requires unit-specific reviewed action, never blanket patient deletion.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Remain RECONCILIATION_PENDING and do not advance the affected unit or run to COMPLETED until all mandatory results pass.
records.reconciliation_proof: Reconstruct every required equation from the exact write set, mappings and provenance; all differences and safety assertions must be zero at the same coordinate.
records.operator_action: Mandatory operator review of any failed, missing or conflicting reconciliation result before resume.

records.durable_facts: Signed or keyed-hash-bound passing reconciliation bundle, all compatible atomic-unit checkpoints, terminal child outcomes, privacy result, side-effect-zero proof and unchanged snapshot/contract coordinates.
records.safe_retry: Revalidate drift and recover only the terminal run checkpoint from the exact bundle; perform no target-domain write.
records.duplicate_prevention: Resolve all atomic units and checkpoints by exact lineage and prohibit replay of patient, alias, contact or insurance writes during terminal repair.
records.rollback_feasibility: No data rollback is feasible or required merely because the run-complete flag is missing.
records.compensation_requirement: None while the full bundle still agrees; drift, missing proof or nonzero difference fails closed and prevents completion pending reviewed resolution.
records.checkpoint_behavior: Advance RECONCILIATION_PASSED to COMPLETED exactly once only after compare-and-verify of the full terminal bundle.
records.reconciliation_proof: All mandatory equations, checkpoint correspondences, privacy checks and prohibited-write/side-effect safety zeroes remain passed at the same coordinate.
records.operator_action: Perform controlled terminal-state repair; reopen review instead of completing when any bound evidence changed.
